title: Oregon Grappling Art

services.name: Adult BJJ
services.desc: We provide each and every OGA student with the same level of hands-on technical instruction. Hobbyists and competitors alike benefit from our progressive and systematic introduction of techniques tailored to our students’ experience levels and physical capabilities. We believe that nearly everyone can make progress in jiu jitsu if they dedicate themselves to learning and applying high-percentage, competition-tested jiu jitsu techniques. The idea of beginning a martial arts practice can be intimidating for many people. At OGA, we have designed our fundamentals program with this in mind.
